“No, I can’t harm lives like this. There must be more to the story…”
“Kill them.”
“Kill…”
…To abandon the past in order to forget the pain — but the price is the loss of that final shred of humanity.
“Hehehe… Ahahaha~ Fragile little lives, show me all your power, come and entertain me~”

124437.synopsis:
After ten years of marriage, Alexander Vance found true love.
He wanted to pursue a young girl as a single man.
I smoothed out the wrinkles in my loungewear and nodded.
As he was leaving, he asked again, “Eleanor Vance, you’ve been a full-time homemaker for so many years, aren’t you afraid of divorce?”
Not afraid.
Being a full-time homemaker was my choice.
I had anticipated this outcome and was fully prepared.
And that girl, she was the twenty-year-old me.

133653.synopsis:
While faithfully continuing a marriage bound to end, he found himself pregnant with a child that had never been part of the contract, nor of any plan.
“I’ve always wondered… why wasn’t a child part of the conditions?”
 “Because I thought it pitiful—being born without love, only out of s*xual desire and necessity. And if I were to have a child, I would have chosen someone else, not you, Go Igyeol. The better the genetic traits, the better.”
Seo Dohyeon did not want the child, and Go Igyeol decided he would protect it.
“If I were you, I’d also prefer to have a child with a dominant omega rather than a recessive one like me.”
 “You understand well. There will never be a time when you give birth to my child, Go Igyeol.”
To safely give birth, Go Igyeol resolved to leave Seo Dohyeon.
To a place where Seo Dohyeon could never find him.

134165.synopsis:
After living for 20 years as a neglected second child and leaving home, I worked tirelessly day and night to save money. On my way back home, I met a meaningless end in a traffic accident.
When I opened my eyes, I was in the celestial realm, face to face with a deity called the Celestial God who governs all life.
“What kind of life do you desire?”
“Will everything I wish for come true?”
“Of course.”
With the benevolent God’s smile, I shouted without further thought.
“I’d like to live without worrying about money! And… I’d like to be loved by my parents.”
“I shall grant that wish.”
Full of expectations upon reincarnation, I was born as a rabbit princess in a kingdom of herbivorous animals.
Still, I was a princess with a human-like appearance, and I grew up receiving abundant love from my five twin brothers and my parents—so much love it was almost problematic.
Everything was fine until the moment I came of age, when the wolf emperor from the neighboring carnivorous animal kingdom sent a threatening letter.
『I wish to take Princess Elena as my wife. If you refuse, there will be no tomorrow for the Kingdom of Harus』
I detested the idea of becoming the empress to the wolf shifter emperor, rumored to be a ruthless tyrant, even more than I feared death, but for the sake of the kingdom, my parents, and the citizens, I accepted the wolf emperor’s request.
“Welcome, Princess. I am delighted and grateful that you have come.”
Contrary to what I had thought, the emperor was very affectionate.
Momentarily letting my guard down at his kindness, I became the emperor’s wife.
“Since we are now husband and wife, we must consummate our marriage, my lady.”
“Your Majesty, you said you would grant any request I make, didn’t you? Then, please give me a little more time. Time to accept Your Majesty.”
For a moment, I thought I saw a displeased expression, but he agreed to my request, allowing me to relax once more.
However, the emperor keeps trying to break his promise, using his mating season as an excuse?
After falling for the wolf emperor’s scheme and becoming intimate, the rabbit shifter empress finds herself helplessly drawn to him.
A turbulent palace romance between a rabbit shifter empress whose main weapon is her stubbornness and a sly wolf emperor.

140053.synopsis:
‘The desire to throw a stone into that lake was a simple impulse.’
Lema, a royal court mage from the capital who came to Kiridara to research sealing magic, finds himself secretly treating the young lord of Kiridara, Ters, who has been deeply injured. Afterwards, Ters shows Lema great favor whenever they meet, but Lema, wanting not even a toe to get caught in the twisted power struggles of Kiridara’s heptadragons over the right of succession, ignores the fact that Ters likes him even after noticing it. However, while teasing and testing Ters as if in jest, he hears a sincere confession and finds himself swayed as if by a whim.
Then one day, Lema’s situation suddenly changes, putting him in a difficult position to move freely in Kiridara. He decides to use Ters’s feelings, offer himself for a night, and demand a deal in return. However, with a composed face that reveals none of his inner thoughts, Ters politely refuses the seduction and sends him back.
The next day, Ters helps Lema without demanding anything in return, and then presents him with a choice between two options, requesting a relationship that begins with a kiss. In the Dragon’s Lake, which had been calm without a single breeze, what will be the end of the ripples he has caused…?

146197.synopsis:
“According to the script, the male lead will stab you next, take out your golden core, and give it to his white moonlight.”
“Really? I don’t buy it. If I stab faster, his sword won’t catch up to me.”
“But you’re the tragic romance heroine—you’re supposed to suffer at the male lead’s hands…”
“I’ll make everyone else suffer. That still counts as a tragic romance. Go hang the male lead on the city walls for three days and see how long it takes for him to cry and call me ‘Daddy.’”
…
Immortal Legends: Weak Waters Run Deep, a notorious web novel that took the internet by storm in 20XX, packed with every classic trope designed to infuriate readers. The heroine is misunderstood, framed, heartbroken, and physically tormented—by the male lead and 108 female side characters—for 300 chapters before finally reaching a “happy ending.” The comment section became a battlefield, with fans divided into two warring factions: “Step-mom Author, You Stole My Tears” vs. “tr*sh Writer Fed Me Crap,” locked in an endless feud.
Shu Fu, an ordinary enthusiast of wish-fulfillment fiction, lives by two principles: “If it’s not satisfying, I won’t read it; if it’s frustrating, screw it” and “No suffering is worse than humiliation; no hardship is worse than tormenting the heroine.” After transmigrating into the heroine’s role, she finds herself neatly boxed in by the script’s demands.
So, she decides to out-anger everyone who ever angered the heroine—by making them rage-quit life.
A lethally sarcastic immortal (♂) × a ruthless, sharp-tongued badass (♀)
1. A comedic xianxia transmigration novel featuring a power couple with bizarre logic, unshakable confidence, and a competition to see who’s the most extra.
2. The heroine’s name, “Shu Fu,” sounds like “comfort”—because this story delivers maximum satisfaction.
3. The male lead is not the original novel’s male lead. He’s gorgeous, powerful, and untraumatized—the cream of the crop. Together with the heroine, they unleash AoE damage on the entire cast.

162837.synopsis:
Yiyoung has been dating his same-age lover, ‘Moon Chahyun,’ who is warm-hearted and mature, for four months now.

Yiyoung hurries to the hospital where Chahyun was transported.
But for some reason, meeting him isn’t easy?
As it turns out, Chahyun was a member of ‘Moongang Group,’ one of South Korea’s leading conglomerates!
On the other hand, Yiyoung, a poor composer and whiskey bar employee, finds it difficult to even visit him at the hospital.
After much difficulty, Yiyoung finds Chahyun’s hospital room.
However, far from welcoming Yiyoung, Chahyun looks him over sharply and frowns.
“This is a joke, right? This kind of man is really my lover?”
Chahyun, who lost his memory in the accident, says he’s currently twenty years old.
And this ‘ultra-childish brat’ is absolutely not the man Yiyoung fell in love with.
Will Yiyoung be able to love Chahyun again after he’s lost his memory and reverted to an insufferably arrogant fourth-generation chaebol?

194069.synopsis:
After struggling through the apocalypse for over ten years, Qi Yu was pulled into a world claiming to be a “Survival Game.”
[Starting with one small wooden cabin—this is your only sanctuary. Please accumulate resources and strive to survive.] 
Wait, are you saying:
Starting with a wooden cabin that shields you from wind and rain, with no omnipresent zombies or monster attacks?
A novice gift pack that provides clean food and water for free, without the fear of infection?
Surviving alone, with no teammates around to stab you in the back at any moment?
Qi Yu: !
This is so wonderful it feels like a hallucination I’d have right before a zombie ate my brain!
With a heart full of piety and gratitude, he entered his ID: 【I Love Survival Game】
Initially, Qi Yu just wanted to live a good life in this miraculous survival game.
But he quickly discovered—
There are rewards for killing monsters!
There are rewards for first-time achievements!
There are rewards for the leaderboards!
Well, say no more—I’m going for Rank 1!
The good news? His Mutated Plant-type ability from his past life was still with him, and he had even awakened the Mage class.
Thus, a unique “Life-type” player appeared in the survival game. He operated a farm, and his trading page sold various mutated magical plants:
Brilliant Glowing Sunflowers: Can act as lamps at night to dispel the darkness.
Adorable Colored Lily of the Valley: Can emit a piercing scream to warn of monster invasions.
Fist-sized Mini Pumpkins: Eating one grants a random attribute boost for one hour.
……
Normal Players: If you don’t mind, I’m willing to acknowledge you as my godfather!
Players with Ill Intent: I have to find a way to seize this miraculous talent for myself.
Qi Yu (Pulling out a staff): So, someone wants to provoke a farmer who knows magic?

196629.synopsis:
Someone once asked Kaixin, “Kaixin, why are you always smiling?”
Kaixin smiled and said, “That’s because my name is Kaixin.”
The person asked again, “Kaixin, then why did you cry?”
Kaixin continued to smiled and said, “Because I’m too happy.”
After a moment, the person looked at Kaixin and slowly asked, “Kaixin, why are you so persistently in love with that person?”
Kaixin still smiled and replied naturally, “Because, because he is happy, so I am happy!”
It seemed like a non-answer, but it left the questioner stunned for a long, long time……

197397.synopsis:
After one miserable relationship after another, Dante had finally found the perfect beta boyfriend: Rhys.
Rhys was his first truly stable partner, and for a long while, Dante’s days with him were blissfully happy. Before long, however, insidious little details about Rhys began to feel suspicious.
He had never introduced Dante to a single close friend. Dante had never seen even a single piece of work from the man who claimed to be a sculptor. Worse still, Rhys would vanish for days at a time, like clockwork, every two months.
“Isn’t that cheating?”
“He might even have a whole second household somewhere.”
As the disastrous, toxic endings of his past relationships came flooding back, Dante could no longer control his spiraling anxiety. In a panic, he brought up breaking up.
From then on, they clung to each other, split, and repeated the same agonizing cycle. They kept spinning the wheel until one day, just before their fourth anniversary, Dante told Rhys he wanted to break up for the twenty-first time.
After that day, the obedient, pliant Rhys he thought he knew vanished completely.
“…You never showed me this side of you while we were dating,” Dante murmured, staring at the stranger before him.
Rhys’s gaze turned cold. “You said men weren’t your type, didn’t you? Wasn’t the only reason you dated me because I went along with everything without complaint?”
Dante froze. What, exactly, had their relationship even been all this time?
And on top of that… what kind of twisted sickness made his now-frigid ex-boyfriend look even sexier than before?
Dante could not give up like this. Even if he had to become the pathetic, desperate ex-boyfriend who utterly refused to let go, he was going to win Rhys back.
